quests.dispatcherQuestion: Oil tanker valve failure releasing crude into the harbor. Input containment code!
quests.hint: Deploy the oil containment boom line.
quests.explanation: Oil containment booms float on the surface and prevent crude from spreading further into the harbor ecosystem.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Crude oil reaching the shoreline near a protected marine reserve. Input protection code!
quests.hint: Activate shore guard at marine reserve 1.
quests.explanation: Shore guard teams lay absorbent barriers before oil arrives to protect sensitive coastal habitats.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Cleanup vessel crew reporting dangerous vapor levels over the spill area. Input code!
quests.hint: Order all crew to put breathing apparatus on.
quests.explanation: Crude oil vapors contain benzene and other carcinogens; respiratory protection is mandatory above detectable concentrations.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Main shaft ceiling collapsed trapping twelve miners underground. Input rescue code!
quests.hint: Send the mine rescue team immediately.
quests.explanation: Trained mine rescue teams carry seismic communication devices to locate survivors through collapsed rock.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Air supply to trapped miners dropping below safe oxygen levels. Input bore code!
quests.hint: Drill emergency bore passage two.
quests.explanation: Emergency bore holes deliver pressurized fresh air to trapped miners while surface teams clear the main shaft.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Rescue team has located survivors 200 meters underground. Input extraction code!
quests.hint: Lower the rescue capsule down the shaft.
quests.explanation: Rescue capsules are narrow pods that raise miners one at a time through bored escape shafts safely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Medical emergency in the upper seating tier blocked by the crowd. Input access code!
quests.hint: Clear the aisle in sector 7 immediately.
quests.explanation: Cleared aisles allow medical responders to reach casualties in dense crowd environments within the critical window.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Structural crack spotted in the roof truss above the west stand. Input code!
quests.hint: Evacuate the west stand now.
quests.explanation: Evacuating below a cracked roof truss prevents mass casualties if the structure fails unexpectedly during the event.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Complete lighting failure in the stadium due to a power interruption. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the emergency lighting system.
quests.explanation: Emergency lighting maintains minimum illumination for safe crowd evacuation and prevents panic in large enclosed spaces.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Fire alarm triggered on floor 8 of the hotel during peak occupancy. Input code!
quests.hint: Evacuate hotel floor 8 immediately.
quests.explanation: Floor-by-floor hotel evacuations prevent elevator congestion and stairway overcrowding during fire emergencies.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Guest trapped in room 812 by smoke filling the corridor. Input rescue code!
quests.hint: Position the aerial ladder platform at the room.
quests.explanation: Aerial ladder platforms reach upper hotel floors and extract guests who cannot use smoke-filled stairwells.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Kitchen fire on floor 2 spreading toward the loading dock area. Input suppression code!
quests.hint: Activate the kitchen wet chemical suppressor.
quests.explanation: Wet chemical systems smother cooking oil fires that water or standard foam would spread rather than extinguish.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Chlorine gas tanker overturned on the highway near the town boundary. Input zone code!
quests.hint: Establish chlorine exclusion zone alpha.
quests.explanation: Chlorine exclusion zones protect residents from toxic gas exposure and give hazmat teams safe working space.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Wind is shifting the chlorine cloud toward the nearby school building. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue a shelter-in-place order to the school.
quests.explanation: Sheltering with sealed windows is safer than outdoor evacuation when a toxic cloud is moving toward a building.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Tanker driver unconscious in the cab with chlorine exposure. Input rescue code!
quests.hint: Deploy hazmat team to rescue the driver.
quests.explanation: Chemical protective suits are essential during chlorine rescue to prevent responders from becoming casualties.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Seawater ingress detected in the torpedo compartment. Input flood control code!
quests.hint: Seal the torpedo bay immediately.
quests.explanation: Sealing flooded compartments with watertight doors buys critical time for crew evacuation and surfacing procedures.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: CO2 scrubber failure reducing breathable air quality onboard the submarine. Input air code!
quests.hint: Release emergency oxygen supply now.
quests.explanation: Emergency oxygen cylinders maintain crew consciousness while engineers restore the CO2 removal system.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Submarine unable to surface due to ballast pump failure. Input emergency buoyancy code!
quests.hint: Blow the emergency ballast tanks.
quests.explanation: Emergency ballast blowing forces water out with compressed air, providing rapid positive buoyancy for surfacing.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Blizzard has cut off the Arctic research base supply route. Input logistics code!
quests.hint: Arrange airdrops to station Bravo.
quests.explanation: Airdrops deliver critical supplies to isolated stations when all ground transport routes are blocked by extreme weather.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Frostbite developing in exposed field team members at the polar base. Input code!
quests.hint: Request medevac helicopter to the polar base.
quests.explanation: Frostbite causes irreversible tissue damage; rapid medical evacuation to a heated facility is essential within hours.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Base heating system has failed in minus 40 degree conditions. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the backup thermal system.
quests.explanation: Backup thermal systems maintain survivable temperatures in polar environments until primary heating is restored.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Magnitude 6.4 earthquake has collapsed a residential building. Input search code!
quests.hint: Deploy the Urban Search and Rescue team.
quests.explanation: USAR teams use acoustic listening devices and fiber-optic cameras to locate survivors in collapsed structures.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Gas mains rupturing throughout the earthquake-affected district. Input code!
quests.hint: Shut off the district gas master valve.
quests.explanation: Closing district master gas valves after earthquakes prevents ruptured pipes from releasing gas that could ignite.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Aftershock warning issued while rescue teams are inside unstable rubble. Input code!
quests.hint: Recall all teams to safe positions now.
quests.explanation: Aftershocks cause secondary collapses; recall protocols protect rescue workers while remote monitoring continues.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Fast-moving wildfire approaching the edge of a residential neighborhood. Input code!
quests.hint: Switch to structure defense mode now.
quests.explanation: Structure defense mode repositions crews to protect homes directly when perimeter control becomes impossible.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Air tanker requested for a water drop on an advancing fire hotspot. Input code!
quests.hint: Direct the air tanker to sector 4.
quests.explanation: Air tanker drops temporarily reduce flame intensity to allow ground crews to advance suppression lines safely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Evacuation route blocked by wildfire spreading across the main highway. Input code!
quests.hint: Open the alternate evacuation route.
quests.explanation: Pre-planned alternate routes ensure residents have a secondary escape path when fire cuts off primary roads.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Rear-end collision inside the highway tunnel has caused a vehicle pile-up. Input code!
quests.hint: Close the tunnel from both ends.
quests.explanation: Closing both tunnel entrances prevents more vehicles from entering a crash scene with very limited emergency access.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Dense smoke filling the tunnel from a vehicle fire inside. Input ventilation code!
quests.hint: Set the ventilation fans to maximum power.
quests.explanation: Maximum fan speed forces fresh air through and expels smoke, maintaining breathable air for trapped motorists.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Rescue teams cannot reach casualties due to thick smoke inside the tunnel. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy the thermal camera unit.
quests.explanation: Thermal imaging cameras locate heat signatures of survivors in smoke-dense environments without requiring line of sight.
